meta.title: tpinv
meta.author: farbrausch
meta.description: tpinv by farbrausch, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 1) taken from farbrausch's fr_public repository (`RG2/Viewer/tpinv.v2m`). The same file is also at fr_public/RG2__ViruzII__tpinv.v2m in the local corpus. 120 BPM, 8:40, 11 tracks. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. This song was not parity-checked on its own; the V2 import passes on the 18 songs that were (within 0.9 dB loudness and 1.8 dB per octave band of the v2redux reference). No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
